# Prose Surface

A scrolling box of prose, named from the heading inside it.

In `library/components/prose-surface/` — copy `component.{html,css}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the surface** — `tabindex=0` `role=region` `aria-labelledby`
- **a pre inside it** — `tabindex=0` `role=region` `aria-label`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — the surface is a stop, and an inner scroller is a second one

## Goes wrong when

- overflow-x and nothing else, so Chromium gives it a stop with no role and no name
- all three attributes kept once the surface no longer scrolls — a landmark that does nothing
- overflow:hidden with a fade, which gets no tab stop at all and cannot be scrolled
- the attribution inside the blockquote rather than in a figcaption beside it
- heading rules that leave letter-spacing and text-transform open, so the host page cascades in
- a positive outline-offset on the inner ring, which the surface clips

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 1.4.10 2.1.1 2.4.7 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/info-and-relationships.html) · see also `data-table`, `typography`, `focus-ring`
